summary: End-to-end tested the engineer equipment-change-request flow and office review + PPM visit tabs feature. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass against the live preview URL (propose add/remove, pending list + pending_count, approve creates equipment asset for 'add', reject marks rejected, 409 on double-approve, PPM schedule detail returns visits array). Frontend: engineer app shows real machine names on 'Machines on this visit' card for case SVC-00026 (Technogym Run 1000 x2, Wattbike QA), Propose-new modal opens, submits, appears in 'Proposed changes · office review' banner with PENDING status; per-row machine-propose-removal-<id> testid present. Service Desk > Equipment shows the 'Equipment changes to review' panel with pending-count badge; expanding lists requests; Approve applies the change, badge/approve-button count both decrement. Service Desk > Maintenance opens the QA Fire Station 20 Nov 2026 PPM detail modal exposing data-testid=ppm-detail with 'Machines on site' (real names) and 'Engineer's workings' (data-testid=ppm-detail-visits + ppm-visit-machine-work). ppm-visit-tabs is only rendered when multiple visits exist (only 1 visit in seed, so tabs testid absent — correct conditional).

issues: Top header still shows generic 'What the customer logged · 3 machines' from the case summary; task spec concerned the 'Machines on this visit' card which does correctly show real names. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: equipment_change_requests.py approve/reject are idempotent via 409 — good.

On 'remove' approve, there is no check that the equipment doc exists before archiving (update_one is a no-op if missing). Low risk since equipment_id comes from the trusted job's equipment list, but consider validating + returning 404 if asset not found.
